text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Now, this month's special feature is "The 
Spring Senior Double Crown". The Tenno Sho 
(Spring) and the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
3200m and 2200m are completely different 
distances. If I can clarify the difference 
in strategy through my interviews...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring) and the Takarazuka 
Kinen? Is there any difference, Inari 
One-san?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
They're both the same damn thing, you 
fool! At the end of the day, both races 
are—

text_block_list.name: Inari & Kitasan
text_block_list.text: A spring festival!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Right?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! As long as we win and hype everyone 
up, that's all that matters!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Spring) and the Takarazuka 
Kinen... Well, they're both the same to 
me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of the distance, I merely 
follow the formula for victory that has 
been calculated, and win.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
They're both the same. I couldn't agree 
more.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Whatever the distance is, I'm the one 
running! I'm the one who wins! I'm the one 
who loses! In other words, it's all me!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Spring is my season. As are summer, 
autumn, and winter. Haa-ha-ha-ha!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I find it rather offensive to be lumped 
in with your perspective, however.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
(None of the Umamusume felt any 
difference. Can you not win two crowns 
unless you have a heart and caliber large 
enough to ignore distance altogether?)

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
(Is there any Umamusume out there who 
clearly feels the difference...?)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Nah. Not at all. These two races are 
completely different beasts.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
(There was one, after all—! An Umamusume 
who knows the difference!)

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"The Takarazuka Kinen is at Hanshin... 
which means Osaka! The Tenno Sho (Spring) 
is in Kyoto! How the heck are they the 
same?!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, food in Kyoto is way too 
expensive. With my wallet, I can't afford 
a single thing..."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Listen up! The Takarazuka Kinen is home 
turf! The Tenno Sho (Spring) is an away 
game! Make sure you remember that!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
That was a wonderful discovery! The Senior 
Spring Double Crown isn't just about 
distance—the mindset and culture are 
completely different!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: To delve deeper from this perspective...

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"—A food tour it is! Off to Kyoto and 
Osaka we go!"
